اضطربوا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَرَبُوا (iḍṭarabū) /idˤ.tˤa.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
# اِضْطَرِبُوا (iḍṭaribū) /idˤ.tˤa.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
